title: How a Brayer Gradient Shows Through
content: The priming color is blue at the top and orange at the bottom, applied in a smooth gradient with a blockprinting brayerthe day before.The priming is visible through top layers, because gouache is often a bit transparent.I'll be showing more about gradients and how to use them in your paintings when I release "Gradients" on September 10.In case you missed it, here's the YouTube video:Sketching a Speed Boat in Gouache—Despite Wind, Rain, and Quicksand
